text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Good morning, Trainer!
Come on, let's give it our all today too!
choice_data_list: You're full of energy, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, guess what?
I went to play tennis with some classmates,
and it was the ab-so-lute best change of pace♪

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"The final game was really close,
but I managed to land a service ace!
Hehe♪"
choice_data_list: They're competing even on their day off...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: "Because winning feels good, you know? It's the perfect way to unwind, isn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Still, what I love the most after all is...
winning races!
I'll do my best in training!
